ChangeList.Description: Added the **crossTenantMigrationJobStatus** enumeration type.
Added the **crossTenantMigrationJobType** enumeration type.
Added the **crossTenantMigrationServiceStatus** enumeration type.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationCancelResponse](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationcancelresponse?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationjob?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource and associated methods.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationServiceStatusDetails](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationservicestatusdetails?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationtask?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource and associated methods.
Added the [error](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/error?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type for cross-tenant migration failures.
Added the [exchangeOnlineCrossTenantMigrationSettings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/exchangeonlinecrosstenantmigrationsettings?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type.
Added the [solutionsRoot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/solutionsroot?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type.
Added the **migrations** relationship to the [solutionsRoot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/solutionsroot?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource.
Added the [migrationsRoot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/migrationsroot?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource type.

Added the [cancel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crosstenantmigrationjob-cancel?view=graph-rest-1.0) method to the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationjob?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource.

Added the [cancel](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crosstenantmigrationtask-cancel?view=graph-rest-1.0) method to the [crossTenantMigrationTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationtask?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource.

Added the [migrate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crosstenantmigrationjob-migrate?view=graph-rest-1.0) method to the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationjob?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource.

Added the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crosstenantmigrationjob-validate?view=graph-rest-1.0) method to the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crosstenantmigrationjob?view=graph-rest-1.0) resource.

Added the [migrate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-migrate?view=graph-rest-beta) method to the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crossTenantMigrationJob?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.

Changed the behavior of the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method on the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crossTenantMigrationJob?view=graph-rest-beta) resource to validate an existing job as an entity-bound action. Going forward, use the `POST /solutions/migrations/crossTenantMigrationJobs/{crossTenantMigrationJobId}/validate` endpoint to trigger the validation of an existing cross-tenant migration job.
Removed the **displayName** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **completeAfterDateTime** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **sourceTenantId** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **exchangeSettings** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **workloads** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **resourceType** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Removed the **resources** parameter from the [validate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/crossTenantMigrationJob-validate?view=graph-rest-beta) method.
Added the **crossTenantMigrationJobStatus** enumeration type.
Added the **crossTenantMigrationJobType** enumeration type.
Added the **crossTenantMigrationServiceStatus** enumeration type.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationServiceStatusDetails](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crossTenantMigrationServiceStatusDetails?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
Added the [error](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/error?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
Added the [exchangeOnlineCrossTenantMigrationSettings](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/exchangeOnlineCrossTenantMigrationSettings?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationJob](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crossTenantMigrationJob?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
Added the [crossTenantMigrationTask](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/crossTenantMigrationTask?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
Added the [migrationsRoot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/migrationsRoot?view=graph-rest-beta) resource.
